description: Get or set the system appearance (dark mode or light mode). The get action returns the current mode. The set action requires mode="dark", "light", or "toggle". Setting "dark" or "light" is idempotent — calling twice produces the same state. "toggle" flips the current mode on each call.

action.description: get returns the current appearance; set applies the specified mode.

name: macos_control_appearance

dark_mode.description: True when dark mode is currently active.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `accessibility_required`: The host app is denied Automation permission for System Events, which reads and sets the appearance. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

title: Control macOS Appearance
